column1: Forests are one of the main elements of our natural heritage.
column2: 森林是自然遗产中的重要组成部分之一。

column1: The decline of Europe’s forests over the last decade and a half has led to an increasing awareness and understanding of the serious imbalances which threaten them.
column2: 在过去十五年里，欧洲森林状况日益恶化，人们也越来越意识到那些威胁到森林生存的严重失衡问题。

column1: European countries are becoming increasingly concerned by major threats to European forests, threats which know no frontiers other than those of geography or climate: air pollution, soil deterioration, the increasing number of forest fires and sometimes even the mismanagement of our woodland and forest heritage.
column2: 欧洲各国越来越担忧欧洲森林面临的重大威胁。这些威胁只受地理或气候条件的限制：空气污染、土壤退化、森林火灾日益增多，有时甚至还包括人们对林地与森林遗产管理不善。

column1: There has been a growing awareness of the need for countries to get together to co-ordinate their policies.
column2: 人们越来越意识到，各国需要团结起来，共同协调各自的政策。

column1: In December 1990, Strasbourg hosted the first Ministerial Conference on the protection of Europe’s forests.
column2: 在1990年12月，斯特拉斯堡举办了首届关于保护欧洲森林的部长级会议。

column1: The conference brought together 31 countries from both Western and Eastern Europe.
column2: 这次会议汇集了来自西欧和东欧的31个国家。

column1: The topics discussed included the co-ordinated study of the destruction of forests, as well as how to combat forest fires and the extension of European research programs on the forest ecosystem.
column2: 会上讨论的议题包括协同研究森林破坏问题，也包括如何扑救森林火灾，以及扩大欧洲的森林生态系统研究计划。
column11: forest ecosystem|n. 森林生态系统

column1: The preparatory work for the conference had been undertaken at two meetings of experts.
column2: 会议的准备工作已在两次专家会议上完成。

column1: Their initial task was to decide which of the many forest problems of concern to Europe involved the largest number of countries and might be the subject of joint action.
column2: 他们的首要任务是确定，在欧洲面临的众多森林问题中，哪些问题涉及的国家数量最多，因此值得采取联合行动来应对。

column1: Those confined to particular geographical areas, such as countries bordering the Mediterranean or the Nordic countries therefore had to be discarded.
column2: 那些被限制在特定地理区域内的国家，比如濒临地中海的国家或北欧国家，因此必须被排除在外。

column1: However, this does not mean that in future they will be ignored.
column2: 不过，这并不意味着未来它们会被忽视。

column1: As a whole, European countries see forests as performing a triple function: biological, economic and recreational.
column2: 总体而言，欧洲国家认为森林具有三重功能：生物功能、经济功能和娱乐功能。

column1: The first is to act as a ‘green lung’ for our planet; by means of photosynthesis, forests produce oxygen through the transformation of solar energy, thus fulfilling what for humans is the essential role of an immense, non-polluting power plant.
column2: 第一项作用是充当地球的“绿肺”。森林通过光合作用转化太阳能，产生氧气。这样，森林就像一座庞大而无污染的发电厂，发挥着对人类不可或缺的作用。
column12: essential role|n. 不可或缺的作用

column1: At the same time, forests provide raw materials for human activities through their constantly renewed production of wood.
column2: 同时，森林通过不断产生的木材为人类活动提供原材料。

column1: Finally, they offer those condemned to spend five days a week in an urban environment an unrivalled area of freedom to unwind and take part in a range of leisure activities, such as hunting, riding and hiking.
column2: 最后，对那些每周有五天不得不待在城市里的人来说，森林提供了一处无可比拟的自由天地，让他们放松身心，参加打猎、骑马、徒步等各种休闲活动。

column1: The economic importance of forests has been understood since the dawn of man - wood was the first fuel.
column2: 自人类出现之初，人们就已认识到森林的经济价值——木材是人类最早使用的燃料。
column4: since the dawn of man|自人类出现之初
column6: first fuel|n. 最早使用的燃料

column1: The other aspects have been recognised only for a few centuries but they are becoming more and more important.
column2: 其他方面是在几个世纪前才被认识到，但它们的重要性正日益增加。

column1: Hence, there is a real concern throughout Europe about the damage to the forest environment which threatens these three basic roles.
column2: 因此，整个欧洲都面临着严重的担忧，因为森林环境的破坏正在威胁到这三项基本功能。

column1: The myth of the ‘natural’ forest has survived, yet there are effectively no remaining ‘primary’ forests in Europe.
column2: 关于‘天然’森林的神话仍然存在，但欧洲实际上已没有真正意义上的‘原始森林’。

column1: All European forests are artificial, having been adapted and exploited by man for thousands of years.
column2: 所有欧洲的森林都是人工建造的，人类经过数千年的发展才形成了这些森林，并对其进行开发利用。

column1: This means that a forest policy is vital, that it must transcend national frontiers and generations of people, and that it must allow for the inevitable changes that take place in the forests, in needs, and hence in policy.
column2: 这意味着森林政策至关重要。它必须超越国界，跨越世代，还必须考虑到森林本身和人们的需求不可避免地会改变，政策也因此会随之改变。

column1: The Strasbourg conference was one of the first events on such a scale to reach this conclusion.
column2: 斯特拉斯堡会议是最早规模如此之大的活动之一，得出这一结论。

column1: A general declaration was made that ‘a central place in any ecologically coherent forest policy must be given to continuity over time and to the possible effects of unforeseen events, to ensure that the full potential of these forests is maintained’.
column2: 会议发表了一项总声明，指出：“任何符合生态规律的森林政策，都必须把长期的连续性放在核心位置，也必须同样重视意外事件可能产生的影响，以确保这些森林的全部潜力得以保持。”
column7: continuity over time|长期的连续性
column8: possible effects|n. 可能产生的影响

column1: That general declaration was accompanied by six detailed resolutions to assist national policy-making.
column2: 这一总体声明还包含了六项详细的决议措施，旨在协助国家政策的制定工作。

column1: The first proposes the extension and systematisation of surveillance sites to monitor forest decline.
column2: 第一个方案提议扩展并系统化监测站点，以监控森林退化。

column1: Forest decline is still poorly understood but leads to the loss of a high proportion of a tree’s needles or leaves.
column2: 森林衰退现象目前仍未被充分理解，但它会导致树木大量落叶或针叶脱落。

column1: The entire continent and the majority of species are now affected: between 30% and 50% of the tree population.
column2: 如今，全欧洲和大多数树种都受到波及，受影响的树木占总数的30%至50%。
column3: entire continent|n. 整个欧洲大陆

column1: The condition appears to result from the cumulative effect of a number of factors, with atmospheric pollutants the principal culprits.
column2: 这种状况似乎是多种因素累积作用的结果，其中大气污染物是主要元凶。

column1: Compounds of nitrogen and sulphur dioxide should be particularly closely watched.
column2: 氮和二氧化硫的化合物应特别密切关注。

column1: However, their effects are probably accentuated by climatic factors, such as drought and hard winters, or soil imbalances such as soil acidification, which damages the roots.
column2: 不过，这些影响可能会被气候因素所加剧，比如干旱和寒冷的冬季，或者土壤失衡现象，例如土壤酸化，这些因素都会对植物根系造成损伤。

column1: The second resolution concentrates on the need to preserve the genetic diversity of European forests.
column2: 第二个决议强调了保护欧洲森林遗传多样性的必要性。

column1: The aim is to reverse the decline in the number of tree species or at least to preserve the ‘genetic material’ of all of them.
column2: 目标是扭转树种数量的下降趋势，或者至少保护所有树种的‘遗传材料’。

column1: Although forest fires do not affect all of Europe to the same extent, the amount of damage caused the experts to propose as the third resolution that the Strasbourg conference consider the establishment of a European databank on the subject.
column2: 尽管森林火灾对欧洲各国的影响程度不同，但其破坏力让专家们提出将建立欧洲森林主题数据库列为斯特拉斯堡会议的第三项决议。

column1: All information used in the development of national preventative policies would become generally available.
column2: 用于制定国家预防政策的所有信息将普遍公开。

column1: The subject of the fourth resolution discussed by the ministers was mountain forests.
column2: 部长们讨论的第四项决议的主题是山地森林。

column1: In Europe, it is undoubtedly the mountain ecosystem which has changed most rapidly and is most at risk.
column2: 在欧洲，毫无疑问，山地生态系统变化最为迅速，面临的威胁也最为严重。

column1: A thinly scattered permanent population and development of leisure activities, particularly skiing, have resulted in significant long-term changes to the local ecosystems.
column2: 当地常住人口分布稀疏，休闲活动也有所发展，尤以滑雪为甚。这两点使当地生态系统发生了显著而持久的变化。
column12: local ecosystems|n. 当地生态系统

column1: Proposed developments include a preferential research program on mountain forests.
column2: 拟议的发展包括一项针对山地森林的优先研究计划。

column1: The fifth resolution relaunched the European research network on the physiology of trees, called Eurosilva.
column2: 第五项决议重新启动了名为‘Eurosilva’的欧洲树木生理学研究网络。

column1: Eurosilva should support joint European research on tree diseases and their physiological and biochemical aspects.
column2: Eurosilva应支持针对树木疾病及其生理和生物化学方面的联合欧洲研究。

column1: Each country concerned could increase the number of scholarships and other financial support for doctoral theses and research projects in this area.
column2: 相关国家可以增加用于博士论文和该研究项目的奖学金及其他财政支持的数量。

column1: Finally, the conference established the framework for a European research network on forest ecosystems.
column2: 最后，这次会议为建立一个关于森林生态系统的欧洲研究网络奠定了基础。

column1: This would also involve harmonising activities in individual countries as well as identifying a number of priority research topics relating to the protection of forests.
column2: 这也将涉及协调各国活动，并确定若干与森林保护相关的研究主题。

column1: The Strasbourg conference’s main concern was to provide for the future.
column2: 斯特拉斯堡会议的主要目标是为未来做好准备。

column1: This was the initial motivation, one now shared by all 31 participants representing 31 European countries.
column2: 这是最初的动机，现在这一动机被所有31位来自欧洲各国的参与者所共同拥有。

column1: Their final text commits them to on-going discussion between government representatives with responsibility for forests.
column2: 会议的最终文件要求与会各方作出承诺，让各国主管森林事务的政府代表持续开展对话。
